prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Move sign-in step to after picking or creating a pet so users form an emotional attachment before signing in.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Live Desktop Pet Preview & Creation Studio: Redesign the photo upload step into a two-column live preview studio with photo quality tips and pet rendering feedback.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Design Your Custom Desktop Companion", "body": "Upload clear, well-lit photos for accurate 3D desktop pet rendering.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Photo", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "subtle"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough: Add a dedicated controls walkthrough screen explaining how to summon, move, talk to, and hide the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_controls", "home_intro"], "new_pet_controls": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Learn desktop hotkeys, summoning, hiding, and talking to your pet anytime.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It!", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Playpen While Waiting: Transform the static waiting screen into an interactive desktop playpen where users can play with pet toys during setup.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "body": "Play with desktop toys while your companion finishes waking up.", "notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_hatch_anim", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Click toys to play while pet renders in the background", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [choose_path, layout] Visual Path Selection Choice Cards: Replace path selection links with prominent visual choice cards contrasting standard pets vs custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Journey", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Back Up Your Pets to the Cloud", "body": "Sign in to keep your pet data, custom looks, and memories safe on any computer.", "hint": "Pets created on guest accounts will not sync across re-installs or sign-ins."}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines & Quality Checklist: Display explicit photo quality rules and a recommendation badge during custom pet photo upload.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with bright lighting and simple backgrounds.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Clear Front Lighting Recommended", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "If your pet doesn't appear on screen when finished, check system tray icons or multi-monitor settings."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "body": "Swipe through quick tips to summon, chat with, or hide your pet anywhere on screen.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Animated Desktop Mascot App Intro: Add an animated mascot preview with clear value promise copy to the initial app intro screen.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion Awaits", "body": "Meet an AI virtual pet that lives, plays, and keeps you company right on your computer screen.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:welcome_mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in step after adoption selection within onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning the photo upload screen into a live preview studio maintains its core functionality.
Adding a new controls walkthrough screen within onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen into an interactive playpen preserves the indication that the pet is being prepared.
Replacing path selection links with visual choice cards keeps both path options intact.
Updating sign-in copy to explain cloud backup does not violate any base rules.
Adding photo quality hints and guidelines to the photo upload step is allowed.
Adding desktop visibility tips and notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning home_intro into a tips carousel maintains its intro function within onboarding.
Adding an animated mascot preview to the story screen retains its primary function of introducing the pet.
